title: Jerusalem Hallelujah (Low Voice)
program_note:
Jerusalem Hallelujah, the closing number of the Max Helfman Composers Group’s oratorio on the life of the biblical King David, called David’s Quilt, is a setting of a combination of Psalms 122 and 147 that together praises God and Jerusalem, the city that the Davidic dynasty would build.
Jerusalem Hallelujah is approximately 4 minutes in duration.
